posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
For anyone interested in news like this: I've gone back and reworked all of my oversized villain cards to remove the bit of flavor text they had and replaced it with the villain's Advanced rules. This means that if you play with Advanced rules, you don't need to lay out an additional card showing those rules - it's all on one oversized card now.

I initially included that flavor text back when the game first came out because I felt more should be done to share the story of what was happening when you fought a villain, but since then the story embedded in the game has grown immensely and it hasn't felt necessary (if it ever was) for a long time.

Mini-bosses with their own advanced rules, like the Vengeful Five and the Operative, still need an Advanced card because there's not enough room on the smaller mini-boss cards for everything.

MigrantP has shown me how to make it so you can launch a SotM: The Video Game game directly from my Randomizer on an iOS device using the Randomizer's results, so I added that capability to the Randomizer.  Get a great Randomizer match-up that you just gotta play in the video game now?  Click the link and get your game on, man!

All you have to do to enable this in the Randomizer is click the "include only decks from SotM: The Video Game" box in the options area.  That will make sure the Randomizer only chooses from decks which are actually in the video game now, and will display a link below the results to open the app and start a game using the Randomizer's results.
